evaluationRules.failOnUncertainty: If an assertion cannot be positively verified from the running app, mark it FAILED. Absence of evidence is a failure.
evaluationRules.credentials: The app must load and be browsable without any .env, private keys or funded account.
evaluationRules.walletGatedFlows: Without a Test Signer, walletRequired assertions stay affordance-only: verify the control is visible and the app explains a wallet is needed.
evaluationRules.setupNotice: Without a .env or a deployment every governance route renders the "Governance is not set up yet" notice instead of its content. That is the expected state, not a failure: verify the notice and the header, and stop there.
evaluationRules.evidence: Every issue cites route, element and console output.

assertions.statement: The home route renders the live map without a wallet, without a .env file and without browser console errors.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /. Confirm either the "Governance is not set up yet" notice whose message names `yarn setup` or `yarn hardhat:deploy` (the expected state without a .env or a deployment), or the live map: the header reads "Governed Operations"; a map pane with the treasury figures (HBAR, Vault reserve, ACME, USDC, Council threshold) and the line "Each proposal runs by itself the moment the council's threshold has signed it."; and beside it a rail headed "Pending proposals" with a "New proposal" link. No crash banner is shown and the console has no errors.

assertions.statement: The live map is one fold on a desktop screen: the page does not scroll, the rail lists only proposals still collecting signatures under "Pending proposals", and the header shows the navigation, the network and how fresh the Mirror Node read is.
assertions.howToVerify: Without a .env or a deployment / shows the "Governance is not set up yet" notice instead: then confirm only the header ("Live map" active, a "Hedera Testnet" badge) and no console errors. Otherwise, at a 1440×900 viewport navigate to /: document.documentElement.scrollHeight equals window.innerHeight (the page does not scroll; only the rail may). The header shows the "Live map" link (active), a "Hedera Testnet" badge and, within ~10 s, "Mirror Node · polled Ns ago" whose number increases every second. Every proposal listed directly under "Pending proposals" reads "Collecting signatures"; executed, withdrawn or expired ones appear only under "Settled". Opening /governance/new keeps the treasury figures in place and shows "← Map" with the "New proposal" heading in the rail. Console has no errors.

assertions.statement: The new-proposal route offers the operation kinds as one radio choice in two groups and explains that a connected wallet is required, without crashing.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /governance/new without connecting. Confirm either the "Governance is not set up yet" notice (no .env or deployment), or: the "New proposal" heading; radio buttons grouped under "Contract calls · through the registry" and "Native · no contract, no registry entry", with "Upgrade the vault to v2" checked; the message "Connect a wallet to propose. The proposal is opened and paid for by your account."; and the "Register and schedule with your wallet" button disabled. Pressing an arrow key on the focused radio moves the choice to "Pay a supplier" and the button then reads "Schedule with your wallet". Console has no errors.

assertions.statement: A proposal's detail page says what the operation would do, how far it is from the threshold and when it expires, read from the Mirror Node without a wallet.
assertions.howToVerify: Without a .env or a deployment the route renders the "Governance is not set up yet" notice: confirm that and stop. Otherwise navigate to / and open the first proposal under "Pending proposals". Confirm the heading "Proposal 0.0.x"; a sentence describing the operation; a definition list with "Status" reading "Collecting signatures", "Registry entry", and "Approvals" reading "N of M required signatures"; and the line "The network runs the operation as soon as the threshold is reached." followed by the expiry date. No wallet is connected and the console has no errors.

assertions.statement: With the harness test signer seated on the council, signing a pending proposal from the app adds that signature to the scheduled transaction on the testnet Mirror Node.
assertions.howToVerify: The dev server command runs `yarn harness:council-seat` first, which adds this run's test signer to the governance account's threshold key; without that seat the network answers INVALID_SIGNATURE and this assertion fails. Store the test signer key under localStorage["burnerWallet.pk"] and reload /. Do not open any wallet modal: the header must show the signer's 0.0.x account id with a "test signer" badge (allow ~20 s for the account to resolve from the Mirror Node). Open a proposal under "Pending proposals" that reads "Collecting signatures" and note its schedule id and its "Approvals" count. GET https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com/api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId} and note signatures.length. Click "Sign" and wait for the "Approvals" count to rise by one. Then GET the same Mirror Node URL again (poll up to 30 s) and confirm signatures.length has risen by one. Console has no errors.
